title: Dyson V16 Piston Animal Submarine Review: Powerful but Pricey
summary: Dyson's newest headliner is here: the Dyson V16 Piston Animal, along with a Submarine version that includes a wet cleaner head. The V16 and its All Floor Cones Sense cleaner head had nice suction on my thick rug and bedroom carpets.
